name: 🥕 Greek Yogurt Veggie Dip
what: Garlicky cucumber yogurt dip with crunchy veggies.

core.name: Cucumber
core.out: skip it, still a good dip

core.name: Veggies to dip
core.out: any crunchy veggie, or pita chips

extras: lemon, olive oil, dill, snap peas, bell pepper

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter.
Grate half a cucumber. Squeeze it dry in a paper towel.
Stir into 1½ cups yogurt with a little grated garlic, lemon, olive oil and salt. Rest.
Cut the veggies and set them around the dip.

key: Squeeze the cucumber dry, or the dip gets watery.
done: Thick enough to stay on a carrot.
plan_b: Short on time? Stir ranch seasoning into yogurt.
